9 recoveries + extra conditions · doubled drift sample

limitations: The alternate and doubled drift calculations share one executable hash and all declared physical inputs. The reference drift calculation used a different executable hash; full source equivalence across those executables is not established here.
The doubled drift calculation uses the original seed with twice the particle count and is not statistically independent of the reference. No averaging of these drift surfaces is performed.
